description.plain:
Complete Repair Solution for Crisp White & Clean Finishes

Restore the pristine, bright look of white surfaces with the Touch Up Kit – White 8000. This all-in-one repair kit is designed to fix scratches, chips, scuffs, worn edges, and minor surface damage on painted wood, furniture, cabinetry, trim, and interior surfaces. Specially formulated to blend seamlessly with crisp white, off-white, and neutral finishes, it delivers professional-quality results quickly—without refinishing or special tools.

All-in-One Touch-Up Solution

This complete kit includes multiple repair tools to address both surface-level wear and deeper imperfections. The pigment-rich paint marker restores surface color, while the matching fill stick repairs chips and dents. A blending pad ensures smooth transitions for a natural, even appearance.

How It Works

The White 8000 Touch Up Kit features a fast-drying, high-coverage formula designed to integrate seamlessly with white and neutral finishes. Once dry, it leaves a smooth satin sheen that closely matches factory-applied coatings.

Simple Application Steps:

  1. Clean and dry the damaged area
  2. Shake the paint marker well for 10–15 seconds
  3. Apply paint to scratches or worn areas using light strokes
  4. Use the fill stick for deeper chips or nicks
  5. Blend gently for a uniform finish
  6. Allow 5–10 minutes to dry before handling

What This Touch-Up Kit Can Fix

  • Scratches and scuffs on furniture and cabinetry
  • Chips and nicks on painted or finished wood
  • Worn edges on shelves, panels, and doors
  • Minor surface damage on trim, moldings, and baseboards
  • Color wear on crisp white, off-white, and neutral finishes

Why Choose the White 8000 Touch-Up Kit?

  • Complete repair kit – Includes paint marker, fill stick, and blending accessories
  • Professional color integration – Smooth, natural-looking repairs
  • Precision control – Ideal for detailed touch-ups and small repairs
  • Durable finish – Fast-drying, flexible, and chip-resistant
  • Low-odor & indoor-safe – Suitable for everyday indoor use
  • No tools or cleanup – Ready to use straight from the package

Perfect For

  • Furniture and finish manufacturers
  • Property maintenance and facility teams
  • Professional restorers and refinishers
  • DIY homeowners maintaining white or neutral interiors

Storage & Care

Store all components in a cool, dry place with caps tightly sealed. Always test on an inconspicuous area before applying to visible surfaces to ensure proper blending.

Bring clean, crisp elegance back to your interiors with the Touch Up Kit – White 8000. Repair imperfections quickly and easily, and restore surfaces to a smooth, professional-looking finish—without costly replacements or refinishing.

Premium paint formulated for use alone or mixed to achieve a perfect, seamless color match on almost any surface. Instantly eliminate color-chart guesswork and perfectly repair scratches, chips, and stains.

Quickly fix accidental marks from family, pets, movers, or general wear and tear, instantly restoring your home's original look for yourself, resale, or rental property turnover.
  • Safe and Easy to Use: Our ultra-low-odor, non-toxic water-based acrylic paint fully dries quickly, so your home furnishings appear like new in a fraction of the time. It is a safe choice for use in all rooms and is safe for adults, families, and pets after it has dried.
  • Multi-Surface: Use this versatile kit to maintain and restore a variety of interior and exterior home surfaces, including wood, laminate, painted drywall, cabinets, baseboards, and metal. The durable matte finish resists future scuffing, chipping, and fading, ensuring long-lasting, professional results.

description.plain:
Complete Repair Solution for Neutral Gray & Stone Finishes

Restore the smooth, modern tones of pebble-colored surfaces with the Touch Up Kit – Pebble 1465. This all-in-one repair kit is designed to fix scratches, chips, scuffs, worn edges, and minor surface damage on painted wood, furniture, cabinetry, trim, and interior surfaces. Specially formulated to blend seamlessly with pebble gray, soft stone, and neutral finishes, it delivers professional-quality results quickly—without refinishing or special tools.

All-in-One Touch-Up Solution

This complete kit includes multiple repair tools to address both surface-level wear and deeper imperfections. The pigment-rich paint marker restores surface color, while the matching fill stick repairs chips and dents. A blending pad ensures smooth transitions for a natural, even appearance.

How It Works

The Pebble 1465 Touch Up Kit features a fast-drying, high-coverage formula designed to integrate seamlessly with neutral gray and stone finishes. Once dry, it leaves a smooth satin sheen that closely matches factory-applied coatings.

Simple Application Steps:

  1. Clean and dry the damaged area
  2. Shake the paint marker well for 10–15 seconds
  3. Apply paint to scratches or worn areas using light strokes
  4. Use the fill stick for deeper chips or nicks
  5. Blend gently for a uniform finish
  6. Allow 5–10 minutes to dry before handling

What This Touch-Up Kit Can Fix

  • Scratches and scuffs on furniture and cabinetry
  • Chips and nicks on painted or finished wood
  • Worn edges on shelves, panels, and doors
  • Minor surface damage on trim, moldings, and baseboards
  • Color wear on pebble gray, stone, and neutral finishes

Why Choose the Pebble 1465 Touch-Up Kit?

  • Complete repair kit – Includes paint marker, fill stick, and blending accessories
  • Professional color integration – Smooth, natural-looking repairs
  • Precision control – Ideal for detailed touch-ups and small repairs
  • Durable finish – Fast-drying, flexible, and chip-resistant
  • Low-odor & indoor-safe – Suitable for everyday indoor use
  • No tools or cleanup – Ready to use straight from the package
